Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1126
Claimant:
Paul Long
Adjuster:
Valerie Rodriguez
September 4, 2023
First notice of loss was received from the policyholder reporting a collision in a parking lot while the vehicle was
parked. The driver was listed as a household member of the policyholder, so coverage for this driver is confirmed.
October 29, 2023
Police attended the scene and confirmed the claimant was in the vehicle at the time. Photos taken at the scene show
damage consistent with the impact described, and the other driver gave an account that matches the claimant's.
November 25, 2023
Witness statements were obtained and all of them describe the collision as the claimant reported it. The claimant has
been represented by counsel since early in the claim, and all further contact is being routed through the attorney's
office.
January 16, 2024
A neighbor mentioned in a brief call that the vehicle appeared to have been damaged a few weeks before the
reported collision. The neighbor could not give specifics, and no earlier damage to the vehicle is recorded in our file or
in the prior claims search.
February 21, 2024
The vehicle was inspected and the repair estimate lines up with the damage pattern from the reported impact. The
claimant's knee injury was reported and medical records show it fits the kind and force of the crash, with no earlier
injury to that body area on record. Treatment has continued somewhat longer than is typical for this injury, and the file
is being reviewed against the usual recovery timeline.
March 6, 2024
The claimant's account has stayed the same in every conversation with the adjuster and through counsel. Based on
the police report, witness statements, photos and the inspection, the file is being prepared for the next review step,
with the neighbor's comment noted for follow-up.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
